items.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996
items.q: When Neal brought “L’il Darling” in it was supposed to be fast.

ctx.x: Basie had a way of tailoring arrangements to feature his sound?
Yeah. What he did, a good example of that was “L’il Darling.” When Neal brought “L’il Darling” in it was supposed to be fast. Did you know that?
